Treat each bracket as a scalar triple product, linear in each slot. The left side \([2\bar p - 3\bar r,\ \bar q,\ \bar s] + [3\bar p + 2\bar q,\ \bar r,\ \bar s]\) expands. The first term \(= 2[\bar p,\bar q,\bar s] - 3[\bar r,\bar q,\bar s]\). The second \(= 3[\bar p,\bar r,\bar s] + 2[\bar q,\bar r,\bar s]\). Using \([\bar r,\bar q,\bar s] = -[\bar q,\bar r,\bar s]\), the \(-3[\bar r,\bar q,\bar s]\) becomes \(+3[\bar q,\bar r,\bar s]\). Collecting: \(3[\bar p,\bar r,\bar s] + 5[\bar q,\bar r,\bar s] + 2[\bar p,\bar q,\bar s]\). Comparing with \(m[\bar p,\bar r,\bar s] + n[\bar q,\bar r,\bar s] + t[\bar p,\bar q,\bar s]\) gives \(m=3,\ n=5,\ t=2\).
